name: Pavilion Real Estate Investment Trust
overview: 2026年，Pavilion Real Estate Investment Trust 的公告主要涉及季度业绩、收益分配和公司治理变动，未披露零售商场运营或房地产投资板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或新合约事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Pavilion Real Estate Investment Trust's announcements mainly covered quarterly results, income distributions and corporate governance changes, with no disclosed expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or new contract in the retail mall operation or real estate investment segments.
